splash.securityNotice: For your security, you need to sign in with Google each time you visit this app. Your access token is not stored and will be lost when you close or refresh the page.

database.syncToDrive: Sync local database to Google Drive
database.destroyWarning: This will destroy the current database.
database.destroyDetail: All existing data will be lost. This action cannot be undone.

sync.fileBrowserTitle: Choose a database on Google Drive
sync.noFiles: No app-created database files found. Create a new one, or import a local file first.
sync.conflictDetail: Both the local and the remote database changed at the same time. Choose which version to keep — nothing is overwritten until you decide.

home.title: Overview
home.emptyBody: Nothing to summarize yet. Set up your accounts and record transactions, and this page will fill with a summary of your finances.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The address you opened does not match any page in this application.

settings.title: Settings
settings.fileGroupHint: Properties recorded inside the database, carried with it wherever it goes.
settings.dateFormatHint: How dates are written in this file, shown as today's date in each format MoneyManagerEx accepts.
settings.languageHint: Stored in the file, so a synchronized device inherits it.
settings.useCurrencyHistoryHint: When on, each amount is converted using the rate recorded for its own date. When off, one fixed rate per currency is used. Turning this on or off changes converted figures for past periods too.
settings.retentionHint: How long a deleted transaction stays recoverable before it is destroyed.
settings.retentionImmediate: Zero means a deleted transaction is destroyed immediately.
settings.baseCurrencyChangeWarning: Every conversion rate will be reset to 1 and all historical rates deleted.
settings.baseCurrencyChangeDetail: The base currency is what all other currencies are measured against. Changing it resets every stored rate and removes the rate history, so converted figures throughout the database change, including for periods you have already recorded. Amounts you entered are not rewritten.
settings.dateFormatUnknown: Not a format MoneyManagerEx accepts; choose one to replace it
settings.retentionInvalid: Enter a whole number of days from 0 to 999

currency.title: Currencies
currency.name: Name
currency.conversionRateHint: How much one unit of this currency is worth in the base currency.
currency.baseRateFixed: The base currency is always 1 — every other rate is measured against it.
currency.noneInUse: No currency is in use yet — nothing references one. Show all to browse the full set.
currency.codeTooLong: The code can have at most 12 characters
currency.separatorsEqual: The grouping character cannot be the same as the decimal character
currency.rateInvalid: Enter a conversion rate greater than zero
currency.rateEntryInvalid: Enter a rate of zero or more
currency.deleteConfirm: {name} ({code}) and every exchange rate recorded for it will be deleted.
currency.historyOff: Recorded rates are not in use: rate history is off in Settings, so conversion uses the fixed rate.

account.deleteWillRemoveStockPositions: All stock positions held in this account will be deleted
account.nameNotUnique: Another account already has this name

account.statementDateRequired: Statement date is required to lock the statement
